summary.headline: ABSLAMC Q2 FY27 PAT fell 8% YoY to ₹221 crores on ₹526 crores revenue, while average AUM including EPFO/ESIC mandates reached ₹11.06 lakh crores.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 total revenue rose about 4% YoY to ₹526 crores, but PBT fell to ₹296 crores from ₹316 crores and PAT to ₹221 crores from ₹241 crores, as employee costs rose on ESOPs and a base effect. H1 FY27 PAT was ₹530 crores versus ₹518 crores. Mutual fund quarterly average AUM grew 4% YoY to ₹4.42 lakh crores, while the EPFO and ESIC mandates lifted total average AUM to ₹11.06 lakh crores. Management said flows in core funds such as Flexi Cap and Balanced Advantage are improving quarter-on-quarter, and SIF and passive products are being pushed.

financial_highlights.metric: Overall average AUM incl. alternates and EPFO/ESIC mandates

segments.name: Mutual fund (ex-alternates)
segments.commentary: Quarterly average AUM ₹4.42 lakh crores (+4% YoY); equity AUM about ₹2.09 lakh crores (+9% YoY). Equity yield about 63-64 bps, debt 24-25 bps, liquid 12-13 bps, ETF about 8 bps.

segments.name: Passives
segments.commentary: Quarterly average AUM about ₹39,860 crores (+10% YoY), with about 17.9 lakh folios. ETF quarterly average AUM grew about 42% YoY versus industry growth of about 27%.

segments.name: Alternates (PMS, AIF, real estate)
segments.commentary: PMS and AIF assets rose from ₹30,300 crores to ₹6,57,109 crores, including the EPFO mandate. Real estate AUM about ₹860 crores (+43% YoY). Gross yield on non-MF revenue 7.4% (from 7.1% in Q1), net 4.3% (from 4.0%).

segments.name: SIF (Specialised Investment Fund)
segments.commentary: Three SIF products with about ₹700 crores AUM as of September 2026; Equity Long-Short and Equity Ex-Top 100 Long-Short launched in the quarter. Management said the industry SIF category is about ₹31,000 crores.

guidance_outlook: Employee cost in coming quarters expected to be in a similar range to Q2, with inflationary increases on top.
New ESOP scheme launched recently: about ₹14-15 crores per year (₹3-3.5 crores per quarter). Existing schemes add about ₹55-60 crores yearly impact over the next two years.
EPFO and ESIC mandates are expense-neutral; the company expects the mandates to build credibility and bring rub-off into other private EPFO and overseas mandates.
Six new funds planned for launch in the coming quarter across retail and non-retail categories at GIFT City; Real Estate Credit Opportunities Fund Series II targeted to close by December.
Management said incremental growth will not come at the cost of profit margins.
capex_capacity: Direct channel: about 80 dedicated people across 14 locations, with a focus on existing direct customers and referral programmes.
GenAI capabilities expanded across chatbots, voice and WhatsApp during the quarter.
Treasury investment book about ₹2,890 crores, mostly debt mutual funds and corporate bonds, with about 17-18% in equity schemes.
Birla Passives launched as a dedicated brand; BSE Total Market Cap Index Fund and ETF launched.
demand_pricing: Flexi Cap, Balanced Advantage, Multi Asset, Multi Cap, Small Cap and Mid Cap funds show quarter-on-quarter improvement in gross and net sales. Flexi Cap net flow market share reportedly about 4.5-4.8%, versus about 3-3.5% in AUM terms.
Channel mix for equity funds: MFDs about 52%, national distributors about 20%, banks about 10%, direct about 18%. Digital contributes 55-56% of SIF/SIP count but only 18-20% of amount.
Retention ratio on redemptions reportedly rose to 25-30% from 4-5% earlier, per management's internal analysis.
SIP AUM about ₹86,000 crores; September 2026 SIP flows ₹1,094 crores from 41.7 lakh SIP folios; new SIP registrations about 7.05 lakh in the quarter.
Industry: MF AUM ₹87.21 lakh crores (+13% YoY); industry SIP flow ₹32,490 crores in September 2026 (+11% YoY); folios 30 crores (+17%).

qa_highlights.question: Why did employee expenses rise sharply YoY, excluding ESOPs?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed it to ESOP cost of about ₹12-13 crores (about 13% growth), a ₹6 crore provision reversal in the base quarter (about 6%), plus normal increments and headcount added for the passive team.

qa_highlights.question: What are the gross flows and market share trends in key schemes like Flexi Cap and Balanced Advantage?
qa_highlights.answer: No gross or net flow figures were given. Management said each focus fund saw higher gross and net sales QoQ, and Flexi Cap and Balanced Advantage net flow share is about 4.5-4.8%, up from a lower level last quarter.

qa_highlights.question: How will the mandates affect profitability and what other benefits do they bring?
qa_highlights.answer: The mandates are expense-neutral and use existing staff, with a dedicated team added. Management expects rub-off into private EPFO and overseas mandates, plus a small margin benefit over time.

qa_highlights.question: How does SIF's unit economics compare with equity and debt funds?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said SIF yields sit between debt and equity categories. Long-short equity variants could approach equity fund margins; fixed-income SIF variants could be around 55-60 bps, similar to dynamic bond funds.

qa_highlights.question: What is being done to lift flows and SIPs, and is the company paying up for growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Initiatives include QoQ sales targets and incentives for SIP drives, a brand campaign, and bank recommendation-list additions (four or five banks in the quarter). Management said incremental growth will not come at the cost of margins.

qa_highlights.question: What is the ESOP cost outlook and direct channel plan?
qa_highlights.answer: The new ESOP scheme adds about ₹14-15 crores a year; existing schemes add ₹55-60 crores a year for two years. The direct channel has about 80 people across 14 locations, with segment-based coverage for ₹1 crore+ and ₹25 lakh-1 crore clients plus chatbot RMs.

risks_watch: PAT declined 8% YoY in Q2 despite revenue growth, with costs rising on ESOPs and inflation; watch whether employee and business costs stay near Q2 levels.
Expected ESOP cost of about ₹55-60 crores a year plus ₹14-15 crores from the new scheme over the next two years.
Core equity flow share gains depend on sustaining the 4.5-4.8% Flexi Cap and Balanced Advantage net-flow share and channel additions.
Direct channel share at about 18% of equity AUM, which management itself described as a gap versus peers.
Rising interest rates (RBI repo raised 25 bps to 5.5%) and potential lumpsum flow constraints; SIF category size remains uncertain.
summary.management_tone: Confident on fund performance, flows momentum and the mandate wins, but cautious on profitability, with costs rising. Management was less specific on SIF economics and on the direct-channel gap, which it acknowledged as an area needing more focus.
key_quotes: Our overall average AUM, including alternate assets, which is EPFO mandate, crossed ₹11 lakh crores milestones this quarter, and now stands at ₹11.06 lakh crores, a growth of 140% year-on-year.
any incremental growth that comes in, is not going to come at the cost of my profit margins, profitability going down.
In fact, 85% of our funds are in the peer group in addition to beating the benchmark as well.

growth.why: No numeric revenue guidance; management says core fund flows are improving QoQ and six new GIFT City funds are planned, with a note that growth will not come at the cost of margins, but no capacity or order-book figures back it, and employee cost and ESOP guidance point to continued cost pressure.
